<details class="project-program" open>
<summary>Russian Science Foundation <span>04</span></summary>

- [Improving non-orthogonal multiple access communication systems using polar codes](https://rscf.ru/project/24-29-00172/). 2024–2025.
- [Advanced multiple access methods for future 6G wireless communication systems](https://rscf.ru/project/22-79-10148/). 2022–2025.
- [Communication resource allocation in telecommunication systems with non-orthogonal multiple access](https://rscf.ru/project/21-79-00160/). 2021–2023.
- [Using non-orthogonal multiple access methods for wireless communication systems](https://rscf.ru/project/19-79-00087/). 2019–2021.

<details id="start-1" class="project-program" open>
<summary>Start <span>01</span></summary>

- Development of a broadband reconfigurable metasurface to improve wireless communications in the 4.4–5.0 GHz band. 2026–2027.

</details>

<details class="project-program" open>
<summary>Priority 2030 <span>10</span></summary>

- Adaptation of polar codes to heterogeneous transmission channels. 2026.
- Rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA). 2024–2026.
- Development of a STAR-RIS intelligent reflecting surface for future wireless communication systems. 2025.
- Common-stream precoding algorithms for RSMA systems. 2024–2025.
- Adaptation of polar codes to the channel state. 2023.
- Simulation of low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes for 5G NR. 2021–2022.
- Research on the efficiency of polar codes for a broad class of channel models. 2022.
- Experimental study of power-domain non-orthogonal multiple access (PD-NOMA) for 6G networks. 2022.
- Development of an experimental prototype of a multichannel communication system with non-orthogonal multiple access. 2021.
- Concept and architecture of a software suite for generating and analyzing 5G NR signals. 2021.

</details>

<details class="project-program" open>
<summary>TUSUR Advanced Engineering School <span>03</span></summary>

- Development of methods and algorithms for digital distortion compensation in wireless communication systems. 2024–2026.
- Development of a communication channel model with a reconfigurable intelligent surface. 2023–2025.
- Development of channel coding algorithms for 5G NR communication systems. 2023–2025.

</details>

<details class="project-program" open>
<summary>UMNIK <span>04</span></summary>

- Development of an intelligent software system for determining digital signal parameters using machine learning. 2026–2027.
- Development of the ReCK-RIS hardware and software system for controlling a reconfigurable metasurface. 2026–2027.
- Development of a reconfigurable intelligent surface. 2024–2025.
- Software for adaptive LDPC and polar codecs. 2022–2024.

</details>

<details class="project-program" open>
<summary>Industry Contracts <span>02</span></summary>

- Joint research with Skoltech on ultra-narrowband communications and 5G network modeling. 2019–2021.
- Development of software and signal processing algorithms for Micran radio-relay modems. 2024.

</details>

<details class="project-program" open>
<summary>Individual Grants <span>02</span></summary>

- Signal generation and processing methods in multi-antenna communication systems with sparse-code multiple access. 2021–2022.
- Adaptive channel-state-dependent signal structures for sparse-code multiple access communication systems. 2019–2020.

</details>
